sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six games, making this a favorable fixture for Sandbach to extend their lead.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong performers. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, travel to Wednesfield Community in what could be an entertaining encounter. Bilston Town (sixth) visit Foley Meir in a mid-table battle, and fifth-placed Eccleshall's home game against AFC Bridgnorth is noteworthy given both teams' recent form. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, with Barnton having picked up a recent win and Shawbury struggling badly at the foot of the form table. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a mid-to-lower-table fixture, while Crewe face Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town (a meeting of two bottom-half teams), and Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with Widnes bottom and pointless so far this season.
